categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of scroll compressors. Its main product lines include scroll compressors for heat pumps, commercial air conditioning, refrigeration and cold storage, and electric vehicle applications. These products serve various sectors such as commercial buildings, public services, healthcare, rail transit, agricultural storage, and cold chain logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core scroll compressor technology, being the first domestic manufacturer to achieve mass production of commercial scroll refrigeration compressors. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including flexible production systems, specialized process flows, and quality control from design through to after-sales service. The company also integrates digital and intelligent manufacturing systems such as MES and SCADA for real-time production monitoring and product lifecycle traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers and operators in the heat pump, commercial air conditioning, refrigeration, and electric vehicle sectors. The end markets served encompass commercial buildings, public service facilities, healthcare institutions, rail transit systems, agricultural storage, and cold chain transportation. The company serves both domestic and international customers, with a significant portion of sales in China and growing overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its overseas presence by establishing subsidiaries and production bases in Thailand, the United States, and Singapore to better serve international markets and support global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of scroll compressors, a core component for refrigeration and air conditioning equipment. It procures raw materials such as motors, scroll castings, housings, crankshafts, and lubricants from suppliers and delivers finished compressors to downstream equipment manufacturers and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening domestic market penetration through国产替代 (domestic substitution), expanding international markets, and continuous innovation in scroll compressor technology. R&D efforts focus on developing new product platforms, enhancing energy efficiency, noise reduction, durability, and expanding applications into new fields such as electric vehicles and large-capacity compressors. The company also invests in digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to improve operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of scroll compressors and related products. The company employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales to customers and sales through distributors. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically involving payment terms ranging from prepayment to 30-60 days post-delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes against international brands from the US, Japan, South Korea, and Europe, which dominate the global scroll compressor market. As the first domestic mass producer, it positions itself as a cost-effective, high-quality alternative with strong R&D capabilities and responsive customer service. It aims to increase market share by leveraging国产替代 policies and expanding its product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 597 million, representing a 7.52% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 74 million, a decrease of 15.14% year-over-year, mainly due to increased investments in quality improvement, R&D, and market expansion. Total assets reached approximately RMB 1.21 billion, with steady growth in scale and ongoing capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its mastery of core scroll compressor technology, offering products with high energy efficiency, reliability, and low noise. It differentiates through flexible manufacturing, rapid customer response, comprehensive quality control from design to after-sales, and continuous innovation.
